landmark_wat_arun_desc.value: The Temple of Dawn is a Buddhist temple in the Bangkok Yai district of Bangkok, Thailand, on the Thonburi west bank of the Chao Phraya River.

SIA_GATHERING_STORM_DESC.value:
The only country in Southeast Asia to escape European colonialism, Siam stood at an uncertain crossroads. Absolute monarchy came to an end after a bloodless revolution in 1932, led by major members of the armed forces and the civilian sector, collectively known as the 'Khana Ratsadon.' 
They succefully have King Prajadhipok (Rama VII) install a constitutional system. A pro-monarchist rebellion led by Prince Boworadej soon follow which was swiftly crushed. 

With many within the Siamese government vying for power and the world preparing for war, it is clear that Siam cannot remain idle on the world stage for long.

ratsadon_member_desc.value: §LThis commander is a member of Khana Ratsadon, joining in the Siamese Revolution.§!

refused_promotion_trait_desc.value: §LThis commander is unwilling to be promoted to Field Marshal.§!

SIA_absent_monarch_tt.value: \n§YAbsent Monarch§!\n   §gKing Ananda Mahidol is currently residing and studying in§! @SWI [SWI.GetName].

SIA_king_ananda_mahidol_desc.value: Following the 1932 revolution, King Prajadhipok (Rama VII) abdicated due to disagreements with the Khana Ratsadon government. As the king did not have a son, Mom Chao (Prince) Ananda Mahidol was crowned king by the government through the line of succession. Because the new king is still a child and resided abroad, regents are appointed to carry out his duties.

SIA_present_monarch_tt.value: \n§YABrief Visit§!\n   §gThe king, with his mother and brother are currently briefly residing in§! @[SIA.GetTag] [SIA.GetName].

SIA_king_ananda_mahidol_alt_desc.value: Following the 1932 revolution, King Prajadhipok (Rama VII) abdicated due to disagreements with the Khana Ratsadon government. As the king did not have a son, Mom Chao (Prince) Ananda Mahidol was crowned king by the government through the line of succession. Because the new king is still a child and resided abroad, regents are appointed to carry out his duties.

SIA_legacy_of_revolution_desc.value: Our country belongs to the people, not to the monarch, as they have deceived us into believing. We revere His Majesty, but the monarchy must remain only as a head of state, neutral in political affairs. We must prevent anyone who might seek to undermine the Constitution, as we have done before.

SIA_buddhism_desc.value: With the majority of [THIS.GetNameDef] practicing some form of Buddhism, the de facto state religion, it has played a major role in the daily lives of the people and, to a certain extent, influences politics.

SIA_buddhism_2_desc.value: With the majority of [THIS.GetNameDef] practicing some form of Buddhism, the de facto state religion, it has played a major role in the daily lives of the people and, to a certain extent, influences politics.

SIA_fascist_tendencies_army_desc.value: With the rise of fascism in [GER.GetNonIdeologyName] and [ITA.GetNonIdeologyName], many within the [THIS.GetAdjective] army and government, including figures like Plaek Phibunsongkhram, expressed interest in the ideology. This interest was further reinforced by the authoritarian, anti-communist, and nationalist policies already prevalent in the country.

SIA_civilian_wing_opposition_desc.value: Since the 1932 revolution, the Khana Ratsadon, "People's Party", has been divided into two main wings, one civilian, in favour of democracy and social reforms, the other militaristic, favouring expansionist agendas and a militarization of society.\n\nDemocrats have constantly criticized and opposed our expansion of our military capabilities, something has to be done if we want to finish implementing our plans.

SIA_lingering_depression_desc.value: The Great Depression had a strong impact on [THIS.GetNonIdeologyName]'s economy, particularly in terms of its exports following the devaluation of the pound sterling, making [THIS.GetAdjective] rice much more expensive on the market. After many economic reforms, we have managed to mitigate many of its effects, but some of them are still visible, and will require a final intervention by the state to get rid of them for good.

SIA_rubber_economy_desc.value: Rubber trees are not native to the country but were brought to [THIS.GetNonIdeologyName] in the early 1900s by Phraya Ratsadanupradit. Before long, rubber trees spread across the country, becoming a major cash crop and a vital pillar of the [THIS.GetAdjective] economy.\n\nIn 1934, the Phraya Phabon administration sought to join the International Rubber Regulation Agreement with the United States, the United Kingdom, India, the Netherlands, and France to form a cartel limiting rubber exports and maintain a high price. However, many MPs argued that it would harm [THIS.GetNonIdeologyName]'s rubber farmers, and refused to ratify the agreement.

SIA_chinese_immigration_influx_desc.value: [THIS.GetNonIdeologyName] is home to millions of ethnic Chinese who each fled turmoil in their homeland. As China collapsed in warlords and civil war following the death of Yuan Shikai, hardship drove unprecedented numbers of Chinese migrants overseas, with many finding refuge in Siam.

SIA_pridi_elephant_movie.value: Pridi Banomyong's film "The King of the White Elephant"

SIA_succession_of_khana_ratsadon_desc.value:
Although Phraya Phahon has announced his plans to resign, the regents to His Majesty have reappointed him as caretaker prime minister until a suitable candidate can assume leadership of Khana Ratsadon.

Two major candidates are being considered: 
§8The ultranationalist Phibun§! and §2the democratic socialist Pridi.§! Though they are political opposites, both served side by side in the Siamese Revolution and currently hold ministerial positions in Phraya Phahon’s cabinet.

Should either rise to leadership, Siam would be steered in profoundly different directions.

§YCurrently the most popular figure within Khana Ratsadon is: 
§! [Root.SIA_phraya_successor] who will succeed Phraya Phahon as leader.

SIA_phraya_steps_down_tt.value: With a successor secured, §YPhraya Phahon§! resigns.

SIA_phraya_steps_down_dem_tt.value: If §YFascist§! support is greater than §!Democratic§! support:

SIA_six_principles_desc.value: Khana Ratsadon set out six national objectives aiming at developing the country and improving the welfare of the people. These objectives were announced to the public following the Siamese Revolution through Khana Ratsadon's Proclamation No.1. \n\nIt is of upmost importance that our government and party promote The Six Principles to the general public

SIA_entice_masses_cost_tt.value: The cost for §YEntice the Masses§! decisions will be §Rmultiplied§! by §Y[?SIA_bop_decision_cost_multiplier]§!

SIA_fire_officials_involved.value: Fire Officials Involved in the Scandal

unlock_six_principles_tt.value: Unlocks £decision_icon_small decisions to propagandized §YThe Six Principles§!

SIA_matchanu_class_sub_fulfill_Japan_req.value: If §YJapan exists§! and §Yopinion of Japan§! is at least §G+10§!:

SIA_don_airport_desc.value: Don Mueang Airport is the largest airport in the country; however, the need to accommodate larger air fleets warrants an expansion of the airport.

SIA_peg_the_baht_to_the_yen.value: Peg the Baht to the Yen

SIA_naval_academy_desc.value: The Naval Academy is of utmost importance, providing programs in engineering and science, as well as naval professional training.

SIA_navy_desc.value: Sattahip Naval Base is the largest naval base in the country. However, we must expand it to accommodate more naval vessels and keep pace with the naval advancements of other nations.

SIA_air_bang_fai_desc.value: The people of Northeastern Thailand have a merit-making ceremony called Bun Bang Fai, which includes firing homemade rockets into the sky. They believe this act alerts the angels and brings rainfall. While we use rockets for ceremonies, the world is at war, using rockets for warfare. The Germans are already researching and deploying rockets to support their war efforts. We must do the same.

SIA_constitutionalism_desc.value: The Siamese Revolution ended absolute monarchy and established the Constitution as the highest authority in the land. Through it, the people rule the nation, and it deserves our reverence

SIA_crown_property_act_desc.value: The assets of the royal family constitute a vast portion of the nation's wealth, including swathes of land and significant capital. Passing the Crown Property Act allows us to place this wealth under the control of the state's Ministry of Finance, nationalizing these assets for the benefit of the people

SIA_renegotiate_the_unequal_treaties_des.value: Our country is still bound by unequal treaties and subjected to extraterritorial rights imposed by foreign powers. In order for our nation to achieve true independence and sovereignty, we must renegotiate these agreements and assert our equal standing among the global community.

SIA_phraya_phanon_steps_down_desc.value: Phraya Phahon has made his stance clear that he has no involvement in the corruption scandal and will resign from the prime ministership to ensure transparency and accountability. Somebody must take his place as Prime Minister to lead Khana Ratsadon forward.

SIA_army_desc.value: We must modernize the army to strengthen its military capabilities and assert Thailand's sovereignty and territorial integrity.

SIA_expand_military_spending_desc.value: We must significantly increase military spending to modernize our armed forces, enhance our defense capabilities, and invest in cutting-edge technologies, infrastructure, and training programs that will enable us to effectively deter and respond to emerging threats and protect our nation's interests.

SIA_national_defence_college_desc.value: We must establish a National Defense College to enhance our military's strategic capabilities, improve doctrines, and foster a culture of advanced military education and planning.

SIA_jungle_warfare_desc.value: We must develop specialized training programs in jungle warfare to equip our military with the skills and knowledge necessary to operate effectively in these dense, tropical environments of our homeland and beyond.

SIA_domestic_arms_production_desc.value: We must prioritize domestic arms production to reduce reliance on foreign suppliers, foster a self-sufficient defense industry, and drive innovation in military technology, thereby enhancing our national security and creating economic opportunities for our country's industries.

SIA_construct_arms_factory_desc.value: We must construct a state-of-the-art arms factories equipped with advanced manufacturing facilities and technology to produce high-quality military equipment, ammunition, and spare parts, thereby supporting our domestic defense industry and reducing dependence on foreign suppliers.

SIA_bofors_artillery_desc.value: To strengthen our artillery units, we will procure cutting-edge systems from the renowned Swedish manufacturer Bofors.These weapons will form the backbone of our modern artillery forces, improving both firepower and reliability on the battlefield.

SIA_purchase_new_arms_desc.value: Thailand/Siam must acquire the latest weaponry available on the global stage, and that includes modern arms across all branches of the armed forces to ensure our military remains strong and capable, to face off any threat

SIA_purchase_trucks_desc.value: In order to improve logistics and troop mobility, we must acquire modern motorized vehicles from abroad. This temporary reliance on foreign models will allow us to rapidly expand our mechanized forces while we develop domestic alternatives.

SIA_purchase_tanks_desc.value: Our armored forces are in their infancy. By purchasing foreign tank models, we can accelerate their development and ensure our divisions are equipped with the tools needed to compete on a modern battlefield.

SIA_army_motorization_desc.value: To keep pace with modern warfare, we must transform our infantry divisions into mobile fighting forces.By prioritizing speed, maneuverability, and doctrine reform, we will increase our military's operational flexibility.

SIA_modernize_bang_sue_arsenal_desc.value: The Bang Sue Arsenal is the heart of our military production. We must upgrade its facilities to handle modern manufacturing techniques and increase output.

SIA_bank_of_asia_for_industry_and_commer.value: Bank Of Asia For Industry And Commerce

SIA_one_vision_one_identity_one_communit.value: One Vision, One Identity, One Community

SIA_thai_use_thai_made_pad_thai.value: Thai Use Thai Made Pad Thai

SIA_completed_focus_through_japan.value: We completed the focus '§YMatchanu Class Sub§!' whilst §YJapan§! has at least §G+10§! opinion of us.

SIA_on_our_own_desc.value: The world has opted to tear itself apart once more. If we are to endure and come out stronger than ever, we must find ways to use our resources for our own purposes.

SIA_enticing_markets_desc.value: Rubber and its' derivatives are all too valuable in modern warfare. Even if it is difficult to export it with current conditions on the waves, perhaps we can profit off this and demand for other goods.

SIA_economic_nationalism_desc.value: Within Thailand, there is a sizable Sinitic population which forms a core piece of our economy. However, with our move towards self-reliance, we must now redetermine our economic ties with the Teochew.

SIA_refine_our_rubber_desc.value: We can use our extensive rubber stockpile to create through artifical means a far larger oil stockpile than we would have otherwise. If we wish to fuel our industry internally, we must build on what we already have in this regard.

SIA_rice_security_desc.value: Thailand has long been built around the farming of rice, with a surplus having been heavily involved in national seciruty since at least the 1500s. If we wish to be truly self-reliant, we should lean on this resource of ours and use it for our own gain.

SIA_to_new_markets_desc.value: Demand is high, and so is our supply of rubber and other goods. We should pursue a more aggressive policy in regards to markets most in need of our goods so we can profit off it and use that profit to build Thailand up better than ever.

SIA_revise_the_constitution_desc.value: Note to later devs: based off the 1949 constitution.

SIA_democrats_and_palace_desc.value: Note to later devs: Essentially meant to show the alliance between the predominantly Phrachatiphat Senate and the King.

SIA_sufficiency_economics_desc.value: Note: Whilst ahistorical, the idea is that cooperation with the left-leaning Khana Ratsbon alongside the Phrachatiphat's royalist interests would lead to a somewhat early variant built around more rampant rural development that would help businesses overwhelmingly long-term.

SIA_acquire_japanese_torpedos_desc.value: Note: Inspired by RT56's focuses, essentially just trying to get torpedos from abroad.

SIA_a_two_ocean_navy_desc.value: Note: Just a naval capstone focus inspired by Kaiserreich's tree. Siam has managed to assert naval influence in both the Indian Ocean and the Pacific.

SIA_southern_bases_desc.value: Note: Inspired by RT56's focuses. Build up some southern bases for the naval air force and what not.

SIA_incorporate_allied_radar_desc.value: Note: ALSO inspired by RT56. Get Radar tech bonuses and what not from your allies.

SIA_modernized_escorts_desc.value: Note: Another RT56-inspired focus. Just about modernizing said merchant fleet and the like.

SIA_may_I_forever_serve_your_majesty.value: May I Forever Serve Your Majesty

SIA_build_small_patrol_boats_desc.value: Note: Will add effects before long myself based off Nuttachai's idea.

SIA_small_yet_nimble_desc.value: Note: Inspired by the tactics used by the pilots within Japanese planes during that one OTL US-Thai aerial battle.

SIA_impromptu_bases_desc.value: Note: Inspired by the impromptu nature of many of the landings in that one US-Thai aerial battle and is an easy focus for more air infrastructure.

SIA_modernized_designs_desc.value: Note: Inspired largely by the 'modern X' focuses in the RT56 tree.

SIA_terrain_mastery_desc.value: Note: Inspired by the RT56 focus, essentially about combing combined arms warfare with jungle terrain.

SIA_incorporate_combat_engineers_desc.value: Note: Inspired by the RT56 focus. Unsure on exact effects.

SIA_domestic_tank_production_desc.value: Note: Based off Chaiseri's later military production.

SIA_increase_boripatra_production_desc.value: There are weaklings in the air force who are begging us to license foreign produced aircraft. There is no need! We should simply build more of our own domestic design, the Boripatra!

SIA_adopt_corsair_desc.value: As much prestige as there is to be had by keeping our own domestic design, the fact is that it just... isn't good. We should embrace the future- and foreign companies.

SIA_reinforce_five_combat_wings_desc.value: Our air force is still hopelessly undersupplied, and as the world burns around us we need to hastily cobble together enough of a resistance to defend our skies above so our troops can defend the ground below.

SIA_crown_property_act_benefit_desc.value: The nationalization of the former Royal Property ensures the state has greater control over key sectors of the economy, boosting industrial growth and providing much-needed capital for the government.

SIA_thammasat_university_natspirit_desc.value: "I love Thammasat because Thammasat makes me love the people"

SIA_unlock_siamese_airways_company_limit.value: Unlock the '§YSiamese Airways Company Limited§!' Industrial Concern.

cannot_be_completed_manually.value: This focus cannot be completed manually.

SIA_infantry_equipment_0_desc.value: The Type 46/66 is a unique rifle, chambered in the Siamese 8x52mm Rimmed Cartridge, which incorporates what is essentially a hybrid Mauser 96 & 98 action into a body inspired by both Mauser and Arisaka designs..

SIA_infantry_equipment_1_desc.value: While strictly speaking, not truly a Mauser, the Type 66 is an upgraded Japanese export Type 38 Rifle with an action similar to that found on the older Siamese Type 46. It is chambered for the Siamese 8x52mm Rimmed Cartridge.

SIA_infantry_equipment_2.value: Puen Kol Muea Type 84 Submachine Guns

SIA_infantry_equipment_2_desc.value: The Type 84 is the Siamese license produced variant of the Bohemian ZK-383 submachine gun chambered in 9×19mm Parabellum. The Type 84 was adopted following Siam's decision to phase out the ageing MP-18; it was chosen both because it shared the 9x19mm catridge with the MP-18 and for its reliability in jungle conditions.

SIA_infantry_equipment_3.value: Puen Lek Yao Bunchuu-aeng Type 87 Semi-Automatic Rifle

SIA_infantry_at.value: Puen Rai Raeng Sathorn Type 84 Anti-Tank Rifle

SIA_mechanized_equipment_1.value: Rot Humkhror Lhoryang Lumliangpon Type 81 Chaiseri Jhong-ang

SIA_mechanized_equipment_2.value: Rot Humkhror Lhoryang Lumliangpon Type 87 Chaiseri Maew Sao

SIA_mechanized_equipment_3.value: Rot Saiphan Lumliangpon Humkhror Chaiseri Type 90 Maemaidum

SIA_motorized_rocket_equipment_1.value: Rot Jaruad Lhai-Lamklong Type 85 Santi Chaiprakarn

SIA_train_equipment_1_desc.value: Ordered between 1928-1929 by the Royal State Railway of Siam, the RSR 260 was a class of 4-6-2 (Pacific) locomotive built by Hanomag. These locomotives, which superseded the existing E-Classes commissioned between 1915-1921, serve as the new workhorse of the expanding railway network in Siam for both express and mixed traffic trains.

SIA_train_equipment_2_desc.value: Also known as Japanese Government Railways DX50 locomotive, these locomotives imported from Japan were the first class of 2-8-2 (Mikado) that became successful within the Siamese service. The RSR later ordered more Mikado standard locomotives to meet railways as well as military demands.

SIA_train_equipment_3_desc.value: As railways started to be attacked by enemy aircraft, new locomotives to serve on the fronts need to be able to take hits from up to 20mm cannons. To protect the locomotive for service against air attack, some RSR 350 Mikado locomotives are fitted with three-inch-thick armour plates along the locomotive to protect the vital parts.
